summary: Summoning order under s.319 Cr.PC challenged in SC; delay in FIR filing; contradictions in PW depositions; sibling implication despite prior knowledge; SC examines evidence sufficiency for joinder; 'more than prima facie, less than conviction' standard applied; reliance on Hardeep Singh (2014) SCC; evidence sufficient to show appellant's involvement with brother in SC/ST Atrocities Act offences; points on delay and witnesses left for trial court; appeal dismissed; trial directed to proceed uninfluenced by summoning validation.
legal_provisions_cited: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(r), s.3(1)(s)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; orders of Special Court (16.10.2021) and High Court (01.06.2022) upheld; trial directed to proceed without prejudice.
